content.text:
All three sizes render clean — no truncation, overflow, clipping or overlaps; bands run full width, the three columns stay evenly spaced, and the photo crops (never stretches) at every aspect.

- portrait 1080×1350 → `renders/s2c2c917d8c/portrait-v7.png`
- wide 1200×1000 (0.85×) → `renders/s2c2c917d8c/wide-v7.png`
- sky 300×600 (0.28×) → `renders/s2c2c917d8c/sky-v7.png`

Per-size `media` tweaks keep it readable: shorter photo band and tighter steps on wide, and a taller band with bumped type (min 10.6px) on the skyscraper.
